description: GitHub Actions fragment. helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests sets pinDigests on depType `action`,
so every `uses:` becomes owner/action@<40-hex-sha> with a `# vX.Y.Z` comment that Renovate
maintains. This is already the house style in mojodojo, casahouse, krtffl.dev and
torrons-infra — and torrons-infra's `check-pins` job fails CI on any unpinned `uses:`, so the
org preset has to produce SHA-pinned refs or that repo's own CI rejects the PR.
Reusable workflows called with `uses: ./.github/workflows/...` are local and are not touched.

packageRules.description: Digest-only refreshes are mechanical — one PR for all of them.
Non-major action version bumps share a PR with each other but not with the digest refreshes.
Action majors (actions/checkout v5 to v6, setup-node v6 to v7 …) change inputs and Node runtimes — always reviewed.
The Rust toolchain pinned via dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.94 is a compiler version, not an action release. Moving it changes the MSRV, which fontes-antiquae asserts on.

description: wrangler pinned as an input of cloudflare/wrangler-action — `wranglerVersion: "4.139.0"` in
krtffl.dev — is extracted by this manager as depName `wrangler`, depType `uses-with`, from the
npm datasource. It is never automerged: the deploy step that uses it only runs on a push to
main, so a green pull_request check never executes wrangler and proves nothing about the new
version — the reasoning that keeps docker out of automerge. And wrangler 4 ships several
releases a week, each one a PR that burns metered Actions minutes, so it is held to the first
Monday of the month: one PR of its own, minor and patch together.
Its own group is required, not cosmetic. A branch takes its schedule from its first upgrade
and automerges only if every upgrade does, so left inside `github actions` this rule would
stop that whole group automerging while its own monthly schedule was ignored.
Nested under the manager key so that it is evaluated after the tier presets' packageRules:
:automerge and :automerge-ci switch automerge ON for every github-actions minor and patch,
and their rules are merged after this file's. As a top-level rule here it only moved the
schedule; automerge stayed true.
It cannot reach wrangler declared in a package.json — that is the npm manager, where wrangler
stays in the `cloudflare toolchain` group — nor any other input of any other action.
Verified against renovate 44.127.0 on a copy of krtffl.dev's two workflows.
